items.title: Fuzz reports ship as HTML · Security Note #1 (Script push bounds) · useful-PoW completed
items.summary: Customer fuzz reports now default to a styled HTML page (verdict badge, metrics, top issues) instead of raw JSON blobs. Security research campaign #1: Bitcoin Script–inspired WASM guard (OP_PUSHDATA1 push > 520 bytes) ran as a paid useful-PoW order on the live coordinator; demo fuzz campaign verdict clean. Open source checker in repo.
items.impact: Operators and B2B integrators get publication-ready security reports; miners see the same pool infra used for research-class WASM gates.
items.action: Local dashboard: Fuzz → Open report · API: GET /api/fuzz/campaigns/{id}/report (HTML) or ?format=json · Guard source: tasks/sources/security/rust_script_push_bounds_guard.rs

items.title: B2B fuzzing hardened · hackme-fuzzing CLI · no browser admin on hackme.tech
items.summary: Integrators now use a scoped developer token and the hackme-fuzzing CLI (Windows/Linux) instead of pasting admin secrets into a web console. Public site: read-only wallet + order tracker only. Remote from_code and fuzz APIs return 403 on hackme.tech. WASM is built locally; POST /api/tasks uses X-Hackme-Developer-Token.
items.impact: B2B clients get a smaller attack surface; operators issue per-integrator tokens; miners unchanged (ISO/Windows pool).

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11g: Windows OpenCL worker (AMD RX 580 full GPU)
items.summary: Windows bundle now ships workerpoh-opencl.exe (mingw cross-build). AMD Radeon rigs use native OpenCL instead of CPU-only ~0.02 GH/s. Tested on RX 580 2048SP: ~0.12+ GH/s in pool (vs ~0.021 CPU). Rig profile keeps opencl when the binary is present.
items.impact: Windows AMD miners get real GPU mining in one installer; pool token and amd_rx580_2048sp profile unchanged.
items.action: Download HackMe-Setup-0.1.0-rc11g.exe · Existing installs: copy workerpoh-opencl.exe next to hackme.exe and set HACKME_GPU_BACKEND=opencl, or reinstall rc11g.

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11f: Windows CP1251 fix + pool token repair
items.summary: Installer and scripts use ASCII-only PowerShell (Russian Windows no longer breaks detect_gpu / write_hackme_env). Auto-repair hackme.env from pool.miner.token on miner start. RX 580 2048SP rig profile applied when GPU is detected. Pool live ~69 GH/s, M ~143M.
items.impact: Windows miners on RU locales: install and Start HackMe Miner without PowerShell parse errors; pool token and amd_rx580_2048sp profile written reliably.
items.action: Download HackMe-Setup-0.1.0-rc11f.exe from https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · Existing installs: run start_hackme_miner.bat (repairs env) or reinstall rc11f.

items.title: Pool fairness: GPU-weighted limits, faster settlement, MPS prep

Desktop miners: use batch 4M + OpenCL/CUDA; remote VPS workers should use worker token (not full admin).
